dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, how do you feel today?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈfiːl təˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I feel sleepy, and I'm a little nervous.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈfiːl ˈsliːpi, ənd aɪm ə ˈlɪtəl ˈnɜːrvəs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Because we have a volleyball game today!
dialogue.reading: bɪˈkɔːz wiː ˈhæv ə ˈvɑːlibɔːl ˌɡeɪm təˈdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Look! Your mom, dad, and Fah are here!
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk! jʊr ˈmɑːm, ˈdæd, ənd ˈfɑː ər ˈhɪr!
